Brings your Garmin account into Gladys: the health values of the day (steps,
heart rate, sleep, Body Battery, stress, weight...), your Garmin devices
(watches, bike computers, Index scales...), your activities, scene triggers
and actions, and three dashboard widgets.

> Garmin offers no public API to individuals. The integration signs in the way
> the Garmin Connect app does and only **reads** your data. Garmin can change
> that sign-in at any time: if it stops working, update the integration.

## Configuration

1. Open the **Configuration** tab of the integration.
2. Enter the **email** and **password** of your Garmin Connect account.
3. Optional settings:
   - **Garmin region**: `garmin.cn` for accounts created in China only;
   - **Time zone** of your account (e.g. `Europe/Paris`), to know which day
     "today" is;
   - **Synchronization interval**: 15 minutes by default, 5 minutes minimum
     (Garmin limits its API);
   - **Low Body Battery threshold** of the scene trigger (20 by default);
   - **Language of device names** created in Gladys.
4. Save. Without two-step verification, the integration signs in right away.

### Two-step verification (MFA)

If your account asks for a code:

1. When you save, Garmin sends you a code (email, SMS or authenticator app)
   and the connection status asks for it. No code received? Run the
   **Sign in** action with an empty code to get a new one.
2. Run **Sign in** with that code.

The session is then kept in the integration volume and refreshed on its own:
the code is not asked again, even after a restart.

### Devices

Open the **Discovery** tab and add:

- **Garmin Connect - \<your name>**: the values of the day. They belong to the
  account (Garmin merges all your watches), so the history survives a watch
  replacement;
- one device per Garmin product of your account, with the **last synced
  device** flag and the **time since its last sync** (known for the device
  that synced last).

A value your devices do not measure (no scale → no weight) simply stays empty.

## Actions

- **Sign in** — signs in (and finishes two-step verification).
- **Test the connection** — reads Garmin Connect and shows your steps of the
  day.
- **Synchronize now** — reads Garmin Connect without waiting for the interval.
- **Sign out** — deletes the Garmin session from Gladys.

## Scenes

Under the **Integrations** category of the scene editor (Gladys 5.1 or later):

Triggers:

- **Garmin activity completed** — optionally filtered by type (running,
  cycling, walking, hiking, swimming, strength training, other). Variables:
  `activity_type`, `activity_name`, `distance_km`, `duration_minutes`,
  `calories`, `average_hr` (e.g. `{{triggerEvent.data.activity_name}}`).
- **Daily step goal reached** — once a day (`steps`, `step_goal`).
- **Body Battery low** — when it drops below the configured threshold
  (`body_battery`, `threshold`).
- **Night of sleep recorded** — when last night reaches Garmin Connect,
  usually at the morning sync (`sleep_hours`, `sleep_score`).
- **New weigh-in** (`weight_kg`, `body_fat`, `bmi`).
- **Garmin device synced** — optionally for one device (`device_name`).

Actions:

- **Synchronize Garmin Connect** — outputs `synced`, `steps`, `body_battery`.
- **Get the Garmin daily summary** — the values of the day as outputs (steps,
  sleep, resting heart rate, Body Battery, stress, HRV, weight...).
- **Get the last Garmin activity** — `found`, `name`, `type`, `distance_km`...

Example: "When a night of sleep is recorded and the sleep score is below 60,
send me a message with the sleep duration".

The values themselves are device features: the standard "device state"
trigger works too (e.g. "Body Battery above 80").

## Dashboard

- **Garmin daily summary** — live steps, Body Battery, resting heart rate,
  sleep score, stress and distance, plus account, step goal, last sync and
  last activity, and a **Sync now** button.
- **Garmin activities** — your 3, 5 or 8 latest activities; each opens its
  details and a link to Garmin Connect.
- **Garmin health trend** — the history of one metric (steps, heart rate, Body
  Battery, stress, sleep, HRV, weight) over 7 days to a year.

## Troubleshooting

- **"Garmin refused the sign-in"**: check the email and password (try them on
  connect.garmin.com), save, then run **Sign in**.
- **"Garmin is temporarily blocking sign-ins"**: Garmin rate-limits sign-ins
  per network. The integration waits one hour before trying again on its own;
  you can retry with **Sign in**.
- **No value for a feature**: Garmin had no data for it today (no weigh-in, no
  HRV sensor on your watch...).
- Check the integration logs from the Gladys interface, with
  `LOG_LEVEL=debug` for the full detail. The logs never contain your password
  nor your session.

## Configuration settings

These are the settings Garmin Connect asks for in its configuration screen in Gladys.

| Setting | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Your Garmin Connect account | `section` | No | Enter the credentials of your Garmin Connect account. Garmin offers no public API to individuals: the integration signs in like the Garmin Connect app and only reads your data. With two-step verification, save, then run the "Sign in" action twice: once to receive the code, once with the code. |
| Email | `string` | Yes |  |
| Password | `secret` | Yes | Only sent to Garmin to sign in; the session is then kept in the integration volume. |
| Garmin region | `select` | No |  |
| Time zone | `string` | No | Time zone of your Garmin account, to know which day "today" is. |
| Synchronization interval (s) | `number` | No | How often Garmin Connect is read, in seconds (5 minutes minimum: Garmin limits its API). |
| Low Body Battery threshold | `number` | No | The "Body Battery low" scene trigger fires when the level drops below this value. |
| Language of device names | `select` | No | Language of the device and feature names created in Gladys. |

## How to install Garmin Connect in Gladys

1. In Gladys, open **Integrations**: Garmin Connect appears in the catalog, next to the native integrations, with a community badge.
2. Click **Install**. Gladys pulls the Docker image (`ghcr.io/gboulvin/gladys-garminconnect:2.0.0`), starts it in a sandbox isolated from the core, and generates the integration's interface (devices, discovery and configuration).
3. Open the **Configuration** screen of the integration, fill in the settings, and save.
4. You can also install it directly from its repository URL: [https://github.com/gboulvin/Gladys-GarminConnect](https://github.com/gboulvin/Gladys-GarminConnect).

Garmin Connect requires Gladys `>=5.1.0`. The catalog inside Gladys refreshes every hour, so a new version becomes available at most one hour after its release.

Not running Gladys yet? It is free and open source: [follow the installation guide](/docs/) to get started.

## About external integrations

Garmin Connect is an **external integration**: a community integration packaged as a Docker container and published on GitHub, that Gladys installs in one click and runs in a sandbox isolated from its core. It is published and maintained by [gboulvin](https://github.com/gboulvin), not by the Gladys core team.
